answer: The beacon schedule is applied in sparrow and pigment makes public each instalment. A payout is split thus 22% arrives at settlement and the rest over 7 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4413 identities would post 4400 proofs and burn roughly 38 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
